tasks.build:client:portal: deno bundle --platform browser --format iife -o public/js/portal.js src/client/portal.ts
tasks.build:client:edit: deno bundle --platform browser --format iife -o public/js/edit.js src/client/edit.ts
tasks.build: deno task validate-config && deno task build:client:portal && deno task build:client:edit
tasks.preview: deno task build && deno run --allow-net --allow-read jsr:@std/http@^1.1.3/file-server public --port 3000
